But did the cross collect the dot, or did the dot disappear for some other reason? Let me check if the dot was already there before I pressed SPACE.
Looking at the initial state, the blue dots were at (16, 48), (24, 40), (24, 53), and (35, 48). After pressing SPACE, the dot at (35, 48) was gone. So the cross collected it.
But wait, maybe the dot was collected because the PLAYER was at (33, 48) and the dot was at (35, 48), which is close to the player. Or maybe the cross arm passing through (35, 48) collected it.
Actually, I think the cross collects dots that are on its arms. The blue cross vertical arm is at col 48, rows 20-46. The dot at (35, 48) is on this arm, so it was collected.
Similarly, the blue cross horizontal arm is at row 33, cols 35-61. The dots at (24, 40) and (24, 53) are at row 24, not row 33, so they're not on the horizontal arm. The dot at (16, 48) is at col 48, row 16, which is above the vertical arm (rows 20-46), so it's not on the vertical arm either.
So to collect the remaining blue dots, I need to shift the cross so the dots are on the arms.

Hmm, shifting the cross up by 9 would put the horizontal arm at row 24, which would cover both (24, 40) and (24, 53). And shifting up by 4 would put the vertical arm top at row 16, covering (16, 48).
But I can only shift the cross in steps. On the blue cross, RIGHT shifts right by 3, LEFT shifts left by 3. For vertical shifts, I need to go to the end of the vertical arm and press UP or DOWN.
Actually, let me reconsider. On the blue cross, when I pressed UP at the center, it didn't work. But when I went to the top of the vertical arm and pressed UP, it shifted the cross up. Let me try that.
The vertical arm top is at row 20. From center (33, 48), I need to go UP to (20, 48). But the player moves in steps of 3. From (33, 48), UP would go to (30, 48), (27, 48), (24, 48), (21, 48), (18, 48). The arm ends at row 20, so (21, 48) is on the arm, and (18, 48) is past the arm. Pressing UP at (21, 48) would try to go to (18, 48), which is past the arm end. Maybe this would shift the cross up.
Let me try: go UP 3 times to reach (21, 48), then press UP again to shift the cross.
Wait, but earlier when I was on the blue cross, UP at the center didn't work. Let me re-examine.
Actually, I'm not sure if UP at the center didn't work, or if I didn't try it. Let me just try going UP from the center and see what happens.
From (33, 48), UP should move to (30, 48) if it works. Let me try.
